note: P8 Phase 2 — Architecture & Schema. No implementation is authorised by this document. All designs are project-local, evidence-backed, and machine-validatable.

UQ-P8-01.question: What CMS architecture pattern should P8 use?
UQ-P8-01.rationale: Evidence from research: (1) Headless CMS architecture separates content management from presentation, enabling Super Admin/Admin separation at the content-model level. (2) RBAC is the foundation of content governance (NIST SP 800-53 AC-6, Strapi governance patterns). (3) Draft/Publish lifecycle is a standard pattern in headless CMS. (4) Audit logging via append-only middleware is a proven pattern. (5) No existing Python CMS (Django CMS, Mezzanine, Kotti) is suitable without introducing third-party dependencies, which violates the stdlib-only policy. (6) A new SPS2-native architecture can be designed from first principles using evidence-backed patterns.
evidence: csrc.nist.gov RBAC framework — least privilege, separation of duties
medium.com CMS architecture patterns — headless, decoupled, traditional models
UQ-P8-01.decision: Design a new SPS2-native headless CMS architecture using Python stdlib only. Do not port or copy any existing CMS. Use evidence-backed patterns (RBAC, draft/publish, audit middleware) adapted to SPS2 constraints.

UQ-P8-02.question: Should the P5 staleness-monitor gap be addressed before or during P8?
UQ-P8-02.resolution: During P8, as a tracked dependency
UQ-P8-02.rationale: P8 does not depend on the staleness monitor. P8 depends on P5's selection workflow and provenance records, which are complete. The staleness monitor is a PARTIAL P5 deliverable that can be addressed during P8 if P8's architecture requires it, or deferred to a separate P5 completion task. Its PARTIAL status is preserved.
UQ-P8-02.decision: Track as a partial dependency. Do not silently upgrade P5 to SATISFIED. Address during P8 only if P8 architecture requires it.

UQ-P8-03.question: What is the P8 technology stack?
UQ-P8-03.rationale: TECH-PYTHON-STDLIB is SUFFICIENT (10/10 coverage, sources rank 2). The SPS 2.0 policy enforces stdlib-only. No third-party dependency may be installed. The architecture must be designed to work within stdlib constraints: http.server for HTTP, json for persistence, hashlib for integrity, hmac for audit signatures, pathlib for storage, urllib for external URL fetching (with SSRF protections).
UQ-P8-03.decision: Python stdlib only. No additional technology stack. All P8 components use standard library modules.

architecture.description: A headless CMS with content management separated from presentation. Super Admin controls structure; Admin manages content. All state is project-local, isolated, and rollback-safe.

layers.description: Read-only content delivery. Serves published content only. No admin access.
Content CRUD, publishing, preview, audit. Enforces RBAC on every operation.
JSON-file-based storage with atomic writes (write-temp, validate, rename). No database.
Append-only audit log with HMAC signatures for tamper-evidence.

feature_flag.description: P8 is active only when domain/cms/ exists AND the feature flag is true. Removing domain/cms/ or setting the flag to false deactivates P8 without modifying SPS2 core.
feature_flag.rollback: Delete domain/cms/ and set flag to false. No core changes.

content_model.description: Typed content model with sections composable into pages. Super Admin controls structure; Admin controls content.

entities.description: Defines a content type with fields, validation rules, and ownership
A single content item of a defined type
entities.ownership: Admin can create/edit; Super Admin can create/edit/delete

entities.description: A structural section that composes content into pages

plain_text_constraint.description: Content.body is PLAIN TEXT ONLY. It must not be interpreted as HTML, Markdown, or rich text.
plain_text_constraint.enforcement: API/service validation enforces the plain-text contract. Any future browser/UI rendering must HTML-encode the value at the output/sink boundary.
plain_text_constraint.security_boundary: Content.body stores plain text. Never inject as trusted HTML.

role_permission_matrix.description: Explicit permission matrix for Super Admin and Admin roles. All permissions are machine-testable.
invariants: Admin cannot self-promote to Super Admin
Admin cannot modify layout or section structure
Admin cannot administer users or roles

asset_picker_architecture.description: Unified asset picker supporting upload, existing media, and external URL. All sources produce a uniform asset reference.

sources.description: Fetch, validate, optimize, and store external URL locally
ssrf_preventions: Resolve DNS and validate IP before fetching

preview_publishing_model.description: Draft, preview, publish, revision, and rollback workflow
preview_publishing_model.revision_policy: Every create, update, publish, unpublish, archive, and restore creates an immutable revision
preview_publishing_model.rollback_policy: Super Admin can rollback to any previous revision. Admin cannot rollback.

audit_model.description: Append-only, tamper-evident audit log with HMAC signatures
audit_model.format: JSON Lines (one JSON object per line)
audit_model.tamper_evidence: Each entry includes HMAC-SHA256 of (previous_hash + entry_content). Any modification breaks the chain.
invariants: No credential values in audit entries
No edits or deletes through the CMS API

rollback_feature_boundary.description: P8 is removable without modifying SPS2 core
removal_steps: 1. Set feature flag to false in sps2/project/LOCAL-STATE.json
3. Verify SPS2 core validators still pass
4. Verify no orphaned references to P8 artefacts
rollback_feature_boundary.rollback_rehearsal: Must be rehearsed on an isolated copy before any production use
